source_policy.reference_data_warning: Hamro/reference rows are calibration and stress-test evidence, not official claim evidence.

selected_components: past-only 10-year analog pattern model when prior years are inside the training window
past-only calibrated cycle ensemble when analog context is unavailable
modern solar override for observed official-sensitive months 3-6 from 2078 BS onward
claim_boundary: Selected as the active v6 evaluation model. 99%+ claim remains limited to GREEN months and source-strict official/printed cases after the corpus reaches the required 528 official/printed month cases.

strict_official_holdout_2078_2083.claim_ready_blocker: Only 72 official verified month cases are present; target is 528.

fixed_all_reference_holdout_2066_2083.note: Stress-test result over low-quality reference rows; not official claim evidence.

rolling_all_reference_2040_2083.note: This is the current 44-year Hamro/reference rolling score after boundary-risk abstention. Coverage is below the 90% target because boundary cases are no longer silently green.

known_limits: The verified official corpus currently has 6 years / 72 month cases, not the requested 40+ official years.
Rows labeled third_party_reference/needs_review are useful for residual analysis but cannot support final official accuracy claims.
Corpus audit still flags 2087 BS and 2096 BS year totals outside 365/366.
The model does not promise guaranteed future official accuracy to 2200 BS; future output is computed_prediction_not_official.

ayanamsha.note: Do not select a non-Lahiri production model until nested validation has enough official/printed samples.
